optional_profile.condition: Occupancy estimation is important and measured local throughput/latency are acceptable.

reasons: Nano confidence 0.10 had identical development directional events but worsened occupancy MAE from 0.1509 to 0.2000.
Small confidence 0.25 corrected one development extra entry but retained two extra exits; its occupancy MAE was 0.1761 versus nano 0.1509.
Both held-out profiles missed two of five entries and counted both exits exactly; held-out entry recall was 0.60 and F1 was 0.75 for both.
Small lowered held-out occupancy MAE from 0.8324 to 0.4134. Measured held-out p95 pipeline latency was 24.8ms versus nano 32.2ms.
Mixed results on two short public sequences do not justify replacing the conservative default.
held_out_selection_rule: Evaluate nano 0.25 baseline and the small 0.25 candidate selected using development results only; do not choose a new profile by sweeping held-out data.
scope: Derived polygon counts from human MOT15 trajectories; selected public training sequences, not official hidden-test scores.
limitations: Two short clips and one fixed polygon
Single-pass GPU timings include cold-start/order effects
Allocator memory excludes CUDA context, driver, and other applications
